notes:
Audio models: Add supported audio.cpp speech, music and separation models from the catalog, Hugging Face or a local GGUF file. Local files remain in place and are never deleted when unlisted. Model details show source and licence status; some models are not usable yet or have unverified commercial use. Recognized speech variants use their matching profiles.
Separation and CLI: Add HTDemucs and Mel-Band RoFormer models for vocal/background separation. The CLI can list addable models, add catalog or GGUF models and unlist them; models install also accepts a positional bundle ID.
Audio engine: Updated audio.cpp to 0.9.3 with an expanded model catalog.
Transcription: Split words joined by em dashes before alignment, improving word timing.
Captions and compositions: Caption scenes support rolling line slots, gradient-noise displacement and compatible image glyph domains. Fixed flickering and reduced frame rate during live composition playback.
Model reliability: Allow more time for cold worker startup, retry handshake timeouts and show remedies suited to the cause of a failed local model job. Web responses no longer expose absolute paths of in-place models.
Design editor: The standalone design editor can export HTML, PDF and PNG, including artboard selection where applicable.
Requirements and verification limits: macOS packages require Apple Silicon and macOS 14+ and are signed and notarized. Windows CPU, CUDA and Vulkan packages are unsigned and require AVX2 and the Microsoft Visual C++ v14 x64 Redistributable; GPU variants require compatible drivers. ffmpeg/ffprobe and an agent engine remain external dependencies. Electron 44.9.3 embeds Node 24.22.0 and does not include the October Node security fixes. Automated checks do not cover full UI/export workflows, live model or GPU inference, physical IME candidate windows or paid agent calls.
